title: A multistate approach to disability insurance reserving with information delays
abstract: arXiv:2312.14324v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Disability insurance claims are often affected by lengthy reporting delays and adjudication processes. The classic multistate life insurance modeling framework is ill-suited to handle such information delays since the cash flow and available information can no longer be based on the biometric multistate process determining the contractual payments. We propose a new individual reserving model for disability insurance schemes which describes the claim evolution in real-time. Under suitable independence assumptions between the available information and the underlying biometric multistate process, we show that these new reserves may be calculated as natural modifications of the classic reserves. For estimation of the model constituents, we employ the procedure proposed in [Buchardt, K., Furrer, C., & Sandqvist, O. L. (2025). translated_title: 一种处理信息延迟的失能保险准备金多状态方法
translated_abstract: 失能保险理赔通常受到漫长的报告延迟和裁定过程的影响。经典的多状态人寿保险建模框架难以处理此类信息延迟，因为现金流和可用信息无法再基于决定合同支付的生物统计多状态过程。我们为失能保险计划提出了一种新的个体准备金模型，该模型能够实时描述理赔的演变过程。在可用信息与底层生物统计多状态过程之间的适当独立性假设下，我们证明这些新的准备金可以作为经典准备金的自然修正来计算。对于模型各组成部分的估计，我们采用了Buchardt、Furrer和Sandqvist（2025）在《The Annals of...》中提出的针对存在报告延迟和不完整事件裁定的多状态模型的估计方法。
tldr: 提出了一种考虑信息延迟的失能保险实时个体准备金多状态模型，并证明在适当独立性假设下，新准备金可通过经典准备金的自然修正方式计算得到。
en_tdlr: Proposes a new real-time multistate individual reserving model for disability insurance subject to information delays, showing that the new reserves can be calculated as natural modifications of the classic reserves under suitable independence assumptions.
